name: Los Corrales (Spain)
description: Blue field with a red stripe along the upper edge and a yellow stripe along the lower edge, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Los Corrales (a horse on blue above a chequy bend on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Los Corrales; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Los Corrales arms — horse on blue above a chequy bend on yellow
